name: Get-NetAdapter
title: Inspect Windows Network Adapters
summary: Lists physical and virtual network adapters, link status, speed, and hardware address.

examples.command: Get-NetAdapter | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, Status, LinkSpeed, MacAddress
examples.description: Shows a concise adapter inventory without changing configuration.

permissions.notes: Viewing adapter status normally does not require elevation.

risk.warning: This command only reads adapter information.

output_fields.name: Status
output_fields.description: Whether the adapter link is active.

output_fields.name: MacAddress
output_fields.description: Hardware address reported by the adapter.

common_errors.meaning: The requested adapter name does not exist or is hidden.
